Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, positive leukocyte esterase, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hemoglobin and low specific gravity are noted; no casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of antibiotic therapy.
